Calculate entropy for a single cell based on its neighbors

calculate_entropy_for_cell.Rd

Calculate entropy for a single cell based on its neighbors

Usage

calculate_entropy_for_cell(cell_name, mat, neighbors_idx)

Arguments

cell_name

Character. Name of the cell to compute entropy for.

mat

Matrix. Expression matrix (genes x cells).

neighbors_idx

Integer vector of neighbor indices into mat.

Value

A numeric vector of entropy values for each gene.
